raw_response:
I am old now, 76 years, but I still manage my 4.1 mu myself with my wife helping. My body is not what it was, so I keep to what I know works. My land is split — about 3.1 mu I run on the wheat–maize rotation like most of the village, and 1 mu I keep for cotton because the price is still decent and my son-in-law buys the lint through a small broker.

For the **winter wheat**, I buy Jimai 22 seed at the agricultural supply shop — everyone around here uses it, it handles our cold winters and the yield is steady. Last year I put down 2 bags of diammonium phosphate per mu before ploughing (that is about 36 jin, giving me roughly 6–7 kg nitrogen and 8 kg phosphorus from the base), then topdressed about 20 jin of urea per mu at jointing. That works out to around 16 kg N total. I add about 6 kg potash per mu — not much, but our soil here is not too short of potassium. I irrigate 3 times with my well: one winter watering before the frost, one at jointing, one at grain filling. If aphids or rust come I spray, usually 2 times. I expect around 450 kg per mu — some years 500, some years 400 if the spring is dry.

For the **summer maize**, I plant Zhengdan 958 or whatever hybrid the shop pushes that year — no-tillage, drill it straight into the wheat stubble the same week I harvest wheat. I apply compound fertilizer at sowing and top-dress urea at the big trumpet stage. All together about 18 kg N, 6 kg P, 5 kg K per mu. Usually 1 good irrigation at tasseling, sometimes a second if July is dry. I spray once for corn borer, once for armyworm if I see it. 500 kg per mu is a reasonable year.

For the **cotton**, I use Bt hybrid seed — without it the bollworm eats everything. I plough deep in spring, apply manure if I have any plus compound fertilizer — about 14 kg N, 7 kg P, 8 kg K per mu (cotton wants more potash for boll setting). Three irrigations through the summer. Cotton needs spraying often — 5 times at least for aphids, mites, and bollworm late season. I expect maybe 220 kg seed cotton per mu; my eyes are not good for picking anymore so my wife and I work slow.

I do not want to cut fertilizer. Saving 30 yuan on urea is not worth losing 50 kg of grain. Better to put enough on and sleep easy.
